APPROVE
`InScript` drops to a cognitive complexity of about 2 (two top-level `if`s), the extracted loops keep the same logic and order of `sites.Add` calls so behaviour is unchanged, and it should build provided the helper parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) match what `GuardBindings`, `Known`, `InStyleSheet` and `ScriptGuarded` accept; I couldn't find the source here to compile it and confirm that.
